_what: the passive tracker's three questions, per name, for the Aug-2026 MSCI Taiwan additions
conditional_on: MSCI adding the name; the probability of that is carried separately

capacity_model.source: IB 5-minute panel, Taiwan, n=43 index-mover windows
limits: the closing-bar share is a MEDIAN across 43 index-mover windows and is applied to every name alike; a quiet name's own close may be thinner
Taiwan's 5-second auction file is market-wide, so there is no per-name auction series to check this against
the multiple is the SIZE OF THE ASK, not a slippage forecast — nothing here predicts price

watchlist.question: Is the market already positioned for this?
watchlist.metric: 25-session excess return over TAIEX, and foreign net buying in days of ADV
watchlist.reference: a typical Taiwanese addition arrives having risen +7.0% (positive 73% of the time) and having drawn +0.60 ADV days of foreign buying
watchlist.threshold: below -1.5% is the bottom quartile of the sample
watchlist.reading: these four sit at the 2nd to 15th percentile — the anticipation that normally precedes an addition has not happened. That is the one genuinely unusual feature of this review and it cuts both ways: less pre-positioning to unwind, and less confirmation that the market agrees with the call.
watchlist.why_it_matters: a name the market has already bought is a name whose index demand is partly met before the print

watchlist.question: Is the flow arriving, and on schedule?
watchlist.metric: cumulative foreign net buying in ADV days, against the drift accrual path
watchlist.reference: the median addition draws +0.53 ADV days over this leg and +1.04 cumulatively from 20 sessions before the announcement; half the drift has accrued by session 5 of about thirteen
watchlist.threshold: foreign buying under -0.09 ADV days by the halfway point is the bottom quartile
watchlist.reading: the drift accrues close to linearly, so no date is special and there is nothing to wait for. What IS informative is the flow: if the shares are not moving, the demand is still ahead of you and the close carries it.
watchlist.why_it_matters: the flow that has already arrived is flow that will not compete with you in the auction

watchlist.question: Did the close absorb it, and at what price?
watchlist.metric: effective-day volume as a multiple of ADV, and the close against the day's own VWAP
watchlist.reference: the median addition prints 6.6x ADV (p90 13.6x), and across markets the close lands within a third of a percent of the day's VWAP
watchlist.threshold: a print under 2.9x ADV means the flow did not arrive; over 13.6x means it arrived with company
watchlist.reading: the close is the benchmark, so executing in it is zero tracking error by definition. The measured dislocation is small — which is an argument FOR the close and against working the session.
watchlist.why_it_matters: for a tracker the effective close is not an execution choice, it is the benchmark; every alternative buys P&L with tracking error
